related.title: Orion 載人太空船
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：結果只用於量級與比例分析，任何熱防護合格判斷還需局部熱流與材料響應。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use results only for scale and ratios; thermal-protection qualification additionally needs local heat flux and material response. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用終端速度模型理解降落傘有效面積、空氣密度與重量的關係。
related.differenceEn: Use a terminal-speed model to relate parachute effective area, atmospheric density and weight.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學質量 80000 kg、速度 7500 m/s，以 GJ 報告。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：E=0.5×80000×7500²/10⁹。 結果約 2250 GJ。平移動能 E=mv²/2；不是全部都進入熱防護，忽略勢能與旋轉。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學 m=9000 kg、g=9.81 m/s²、ρ=1.2 kg/m³、Cd=1.5、總有效面積 1200 m²。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：v=sqrt(2×9000×9.81/(1.2×1.5×1200))。 結果約 9.04157 m/s。穩態垂直下降 v=sqrt(2mg/(ρCdA))；忽略開傘瞬態、擺動與傘間干擾。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching mass 80000 kg and speed 7500 m/s; report in GJ. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: E=0.5×80000×7500²/10⁹. Result ≈ 2250 GJ. Translational E=mv²/2 is not all absorbed by thermal protection and excludes potential and rotational energy.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching m=9000 kg, g=9.81 m/s², ρ=1.2 kg/m³, Cd=1.5 and total effective area 1200 m². Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: v=sqrt(2×9000×9.81/(1.2×1.5×1200)). Result ≈ 9.04157 m/s. Steady vertical descent v=sqrt(2mg/(ρCdA)) excludes deployment transients, swing and canopy interference.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Galileo 衛星定位系統
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：結果只用於量級與比例分析，任何熱防護合格判斷還需局部熱流與材料響應。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use results only for scale and ratios; thermal-protection qualification additionally needs local heat flux and material response. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 分離測距精度與衛星幾何稀釋效應，避免只按衛星顆數選解。
related.differenceEn: Separate range precision from geometric dilution and avoid choosing solutions by satellite count alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學質量 80000 kg、速度 7500 m/s，以 GJ 報告。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：E=0.5×80000×7500²/10⁹。 結果約 2250 GJ。平移動能 E=mv²/2；不是全部都進入熱防護，忽略勢能與旋轉。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成測距 1σ=3 m、PDOP=2.5，指三維位置誤差尺度。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：σ位置=2.5×3。 結果約 7.5 m。等方差線性化近似 σ位置≈PDOP×σ測距；相關誤差或非線性偏差需另建模。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching mass 80000 kg and speed 7500 m/s; report in GJ. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: E=0.5×80000×7500²/10⁹. Result ≈ 2250 GJ. Translational E=mv²/2 is not all absorbed by thermal protection and excludes potential and rotational energy.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic range 1σ is 3 m and PDOP=2.5, representing a 3-D position error scale. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: σposition=2.5×3. Result ≈ 7.5 m. Under equal-variance linearization σposition≈PDOP×σrange; correlated errors and nonlinear bias need separate models.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
